story: Tallulah Gorge State Park is a 2,689-acre state park located in Georgia, USA, along the county line between Rabun and Habersham Counties. The park surrounds Tallulah Gorge, a 1,000-foot deep gorge formed by the Tallulah River, featuring six waterfalls known as the Tallulah Falls.
matters: The park surrounds Tallulah Gorge, which is formed by the action of the Tallulah River running along the floor of the gorge.
name: Tallulah Gorge State Park
